verdict.rationale: Folk's own marketing lists in-product AI features: 'Generate AI-powered custom fields' and 'AI Assistants' on its pricing page. These suggest AI-generated content derived from CRM data inside the product, but both are single-line mentions with no description of insights or suggestions. The MCP use cases run in external assistants (Claude, ChatGPT), so they do not count as in-product insights. Missing for 10: documentation of AI insights or recommendations surfaced from user data, detail on what the AI Assistants actually do, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
